sections.subhead: Moving Your Site Without Losing Traffic, Rankings, or Data

body.html: WordPress Migration Services Kochi is what Teknoppy provides when a website needs to move — to a new host, a new domain, or onto WordPress from another platform entirely — without breaking anything along the way. A migration sounds simple until it isn't: a missed database table, a broken redirect, an email service that stops working mid-switch. We handle the move as a planned, tested process rather than a copy-paste job done live on production, so the site comes back up exactly as it should.

Businesses across Kochi usually need this for one of a few reasons — a hosting renewal that's become too expensive, a developer relationship that's ending, or outgrowing a builder platform that can't scale anymore. WordPress Migration Services Kochi work exists to make that transition invisible to your visitors and safe for your search rankings, instead of a stressful weekend of troubleshooting.

items.title: WordPress Site Migration
items.html: Our WordPress site migration Kochi process covers a full transfer of files, database, plugins, and configuration from the old environment to the new one, verified against the original before the switch goes live.

items.title: Hosting Migration
items.html: A WordPress hosting migration service moves your site to a new host without the downtime that comes from doing it manually — DNS, SSL certificates, and email routing are all planned in advance, not fixed after something breaks.

items.title: Domain Migration
items.html: WordPress domain migration Kochi work includes a full URL redirect map, so search engines and existing links follow the site to its new address instead of returning dead pages.

items.title: Platform-to-WordPress Migration
items.html: If you're not already on WordPress, our team also handles website migration to WordPress from builders like Wix, Squarespace, or Shopify — rebuilding the content and structure natively rather than importing a messy export file.

items.title: Pre-Migration Audit
items.text: We map every plugin, page, form, and integration on the current site so nothing gets missed during the move.

items.title: Staging Environment Setup
items.text: The site is rebuilt on a staging copy of the new host first, so the live site stays untouched until everything is verified.

items.title: Data & Database Transfer
items.text: Our WordPress data migration Kochi process moves content, media, and database tables with a checksum comparison against the original.

items.title: DNS & Redirect Cutover
items.text: Timed for low-traffic hours, with a full WordPress migration checklist followed step by step to catch anything that could break during the switch.

items.title: Post-Migration Verification
items.text: Every page, form, and integration is re-tested on the live site immediately after cutover, not left to be discovered broken later.

Businesses considering WordPress Migration Services Kochi work usually already know which of these situations applies to them, which is why we start every project with a short scoping call rather than a blind quote.

paragraphs.html: Teknoppy has migrated WordPress sites across Kochi and Kerala between hosts, domains, and from other platforms — each one planned and tested before going live. See related work in our Website Projects Portfolio.

sections.h2: Frequently Asked Questions — WordPress Migration Services Kochi

items.q: What does WordPress migration service include?
items.a: It includes a full audit, staging setup, database and file transfer, DNS and redirect cutover, and post-migration testing — everything needed to move a site without losing data, rankings, or functionality.

items.q: Can you migrate my website to WordPress Kochi businesses trust from another platform?
items.a: Yes. If you want to migrate website to WordPress Kochi from Wix, Squarespace, Shopify, or another builder, we rebuild the site natively on WordPress rather than relying on an automated import.

items.q: Will migration affect my Google rankings?
items.a: Not if done correctly. A proper URL redirect map and unchanged content structure mean search engines follow the site to its new location without losing indexed rankings.

items.q: Do you offer emergency migration support?
items.a: Yes. Emergency website migration Kochi support is available if your current host is failing, your site is down, or you need to move on short notice.

items.q: How long does a typical migration take?
items.a: Most migrations are completed within a planned maintenance window of a few hours, though the audit and staging setup beforehand can take several days depending on site complexity.

sections.h2: Ready to Move Your Website Without the Risk?

paragraphs.text: A poorly handled migration can cost you search rankings, broken forms, and days of downtime. Teknoppy's WordPress migration team plans the move, tests it on staging first, and verifies everything before calling it done.
